issues.description: The problem UML and description specify acceptSupplyDelivery as a public method (+acceptSupplyDelivery(String, int, int): void) and explicitly require it to be static. In the solution, acceptSupplyDelivery is declared as a package-private static method (no visibility modifier). This visibility mismatch may confuse students about the expected API and can prevent callers outside the package from invoking the method as intended.
issues.suggestedFix: Declare acceptSupplyDelivery as public static in the SealSaloon class (public static void acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity)) both in the template and reference solution so it matches the UML/requirements and is callable from outside the package.
